title: The 8 Levels of Fast Fashion Debt
house: A bustling metropolis named Veggieopolis where fruit and vegetable citizens walk down neon-lit concrete sidewalks, dodging yellow cab lemons and rushing past shiny automated Klarna kiosks.
catchphrase: The number on your forehead never lies.

levels.name: Mia, 21, Intern
levels.story: The 8 levels of secret fast fashion debt. Level 1. Three million dollars in debt and my fourth Klarna package just arrived at the door. My Strawberry head is dripping with nervous sweat as I tear open the cardboard box on my stained kitchen floor. You seriously bought more cheap clothes while your account is locked? I needed the dopamine hit just to survive this miserable internship. You belong in a dumpster, not a boutique. Wait, did you hear that strange scratching sound coming from behind the peeling wallpaper in the hallway? Nobody is out there, Mia. You are just losing your mind over a few cheap polyester dresses. I am telling you, someone is watching my every move through the ventilation shaft right now. You'll see that in Level 2.

I only make twelve bucks an hour plus tips, but my cart keeps auto-checking out trendy pants. Your entire life is just one giant clearance sale nobody wants. Listen to me, Zoe, I am paying off every single cent of this debt by next month, I swear. Save your breath, Oliver. The audit team is already parked outside in a black van. Oh no, they found out about the second storage unit on 4th Street, didn't they? You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Leo, 28, Dispatcher
levels.story: Level 4. Eight hundred thousand dollars in debt and my entire living room is blocked by twenty unopened parcel boxes. My Lemon head is stinging with sour regret as I sort through shipping labels on the floor. This building is for paying tenants, not package hoarders. I keep clicking buy now because the instant dopamine rush makes me forget my miserable life. Your financial funeral is scheduled for tomorrow morning. You cannot evict me like this without a formal warning letter from the municipal housing board. The board already signed your eviction warrant an hour ago, Leo. Then what are all these extra delivery trucks idling down in the alleyway right now? You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Maya, 25, Influencer
levels.story: Level 5. Three hundred fifty thousand in debt and I am staging a fake luxury photoshoot in a rented hotel room. My Coconut shell feels hollow and brittle as I adjust the ring light for my TikTok live stream. You are drowning in consumer debt and pretending to be rich for views. I tell myself that just one more viral video will pay off all my Klarna balances. Your bankruptcy will be the best show this city has ever streamed. My followers believe every single post I make, they will never find out the truth. The truth is already trending worldwide under the hashtag #FakeInfluencer, Maya. No, please cut the live stream feed before my brand sponsors see my real bank balance! You'll see that in Level 6.

levels.name: Sam, 29, Accountant
levels.story: Level 6. Ninety thousand dollars in debt and I am finally cutting up my virtual shopping cards one by one over the kitchen sink. My crisp Broccoli florets are trembling as I balance my actual monthly budget. You actually have a manageable negative balance while I am drowning in packages. My job as a corporate accountant taught me how deep the city's fast fashion addiction really goes. You only look successful because you hide your garbage better than the rest of us. Chloe, look at these ledger entries from the central bank, the numbers do not add up at all. What are you talking about, Sam? Those are just standard corporate tax documents. No, someone deliberately manipulated our accounts to keep us trapped in permanent debt loops. You'll see that in Level 7.

My Pine crown stands tall as I gaze out over the endless neon skyline from the top floor of the corporate tower. You are the one who engineered all our shopping addictions and automated debt traps. Every package delivered, every impulse purchase checked out at 2 AM, was designed to feed this empire. The number on your forehead isn't your net worth, it's just the price tag I assigned to your soul. Your reign over Veggieopolis ends right now, King Pine. Every citizen is waking up. Let them wake up. They will always crawl back to my shopping apps by midnight. Look at your own forehead screen right now. Your net worth is dropping to zero. You'll see that in Level 1.
